description: Get the tag value distribution of a Sentry issue: counts of each browser, environment, release, URL, or other tag value affected. Tag keys vary by platform, SDK, and custom tags.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

tagKey.description: Case-sensitive tag key from the issue's tags, e.g. `environment` or `release`.

name: get_issue_tag_values
title: Get Issue Tag Values
